turns.user: How do I rename a notebook?
turns.reply: Go to your settings > notebooks, tap the notebook name, then enter a new name and save. [END]

turns.user: How do I sign out on all devices?
turns.reply: Go to settings > logout from all devices. [END]

turns.user: What happens when I delete a note?
turns.reply: It's permanently deleted but can be recovered if needed. [END]

turns.user: Can I use Acme Notes offline?
turns.reply: Yes, it syncs automatically so you can use it offline. [END]

turns.user: How do I merge two notebooks?
turns.reply: In settings, select both notebooks, choose "merge," and follow prompts. [END]

turns.user: How do I reset my password?
